title: Handling a Difficult Customer
paragraphs: Working at the customer service desk, Rian faces an angry customer complaining loudly about a delayed order, raising his voice enough that other customers nearby begin to notice the scene.
Rather than responding defensively, Rian keeps his voice calm and steady, apologizing sincerely for the inconvenience and explaining clearly what steps he will personally take to resolve the issue.
The customer's tone gradually softens once he realizes Rian is genuinely trying to help rather than making excuses, and by the end of the conversation, he even thanks Rian for his patience.
Reflecting afterward, Rian tells a coworker that staying calm under pressure, even when someone else loses their temper, usually resolves situations faster than matching their frustration.
